# AGENTS.md — rtifact-platform-installer

Instructions for humans and AI agents working in this repository.

## Runtime

- **OpenTofu only.** Use the `tofu` CLI (`plan`, `apply`, `destroy`, `validate`, `fmt`, `init`). Never invoke HashiCorp Terraform (`terraform`).
- The Go installer (`cmd/installer`) only executes `tofu`.

## Provider sources

- Pin providers from the **[OpenTofu Registry](https://search.opentofu.org/providers)** only.
- Use the **`opentofu/` namespace** (e.g. `opentofu/azurerm`, `opentofu/random`, `opentofu/tls`), not `hashicorp/*`.
- Provider pins are in each stack `versions.tofu` (`terraform { required_providers { ... } }`). Modules keep `providers.tofu` without version pins.
- On `tofu init`, the registry may show informational notes comparing `opentofu/*` and `hashicorp/*` namespaces; **ignore those** — this project standardizes on `opentofu/*`.

## Configuration files

- **Do not add new `.tf` files.** All OpenTofu configuration must use the **`.tofu`** extension (e.g. `main.tofu`, `variables.tofu`, `providers.tofu`).
- Variable files for customers stay **YAML** (e.g. `<customer>-<env>-<purpose>.yaml` **external** to the repo).
- Customer contract (schema v1): top-level `cloud`, `account`, `workload`, and explicit `features.*` booleans in the customer file (validated against the profile registry).
- Generated at apply time: `installer.auto.tfvars.json` (passed via `-var-file`) and `backend.tofu` (from `cloud.Backend()`); local state lives under `~/.rtifact-installer/<prefix>/state/`.
- New IaC modules/resources must be behind a `features.<name>` flag in the stack.

## Layout

- `infra/modules/<cloud>/` — reusable building blocks (`providers.tofu` + `*.tofu`).
- `infra/stacks/<profile>/<cloud>/<layer>/` — composition roots; **only stacks** configure cloud provider blocks (`azurerm`, `aws`, `google`).
- `profiles/<profile>/<cloud>/` — per-cloud defaults, features, and tiers (not customer-specific).
- `schemas/<cloud>.schema.json`, `examples/<cloud>/`, `tests/config/contracts/<cloud>.yaml` — per cloud only.
- Customer values live **outside** this repo.

## Cloud layout rules

1. A cloud's files live only under that cloud's paths (`profiles/.../<cloud>/`, `examples/<cloud>/`, etc.); never reference another cloud's names or keys.
2. Every capability has exactly one `features.<name>` switch (default false). Do not add `enabled` keys inside config sections.
3. No customer-specific default values in `*.tofu` files; defaults belong in `profiles/<id>/<cloud>/defaults.yaml`.

## When changing IaC

1. Match provider schemas for your cloud ([azurerm 5.x](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/opentofu/azurerm/latest), [aws](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/opentofu/aws/latest), [google](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/opentofu/google/latest)); avoid deprecated arguments (e.g. storage account uses `public_network_access`, not `public_network_access_enabled`).
2. Run `make tofu-pre-commit-fast` (or `tofu fmt -recursive infra/` and `make tofu-validate`).
3. Update `infra/stacks/<profile>/<cloud>/<layer>/.terraform.lock.hcl` when provider versions change (`tofu init -upgrade` in the stack dir or `make tofu-pre-commit` to refresh locks).
4. Run `make package-content` before release builds.

## Build

```bash
make build-dev
make tofu-validate
./dist/rtifact validate examples/sandbox.yaml
```

Release: `make release` (embeds OpenTofu + provider mirror).

## Managed vs installer-owned

**Managed** (regenerated by `make boilerplate-update`): paths listed in `boilerplate-manifest.yaml` (checksums + template sources). Do not hand-edit.

**Installer-owned**: all `*.tofu` with resources, `internal/`, `cmd/`, `Makefile` product targets, `profiles/`, `schemas/`, release workflows.

Logic is edited **in this repo only**. Managed structure/tooling is edited in **boilerplates** `devops-templates/rtifact-product`, then pulled with `make boilerplate-update`.

## Boilerplates checkout

Use sibling `../boilerplates` for template development; before push set `BOILERPLATES_TEMPLATE_URL` to `github.com/cipherops-io/boilerplates//devops-templates/rtifact-product?ref=v3.3.0`.

Templates: `rtifact-product` (managed sync), `rtifact-stack`, `rtifact-module`, `rtifact-cloud`, `rtifact-deploy` (one-shot scaffolds).

## Infrastructure vs deploy configuration

Infrastructure YAML and deploy YAML are separate contracts and never share keys. For deploy configuration and release rules, read `deploy/AGENTS.md`.

## Backport rules

| Change type | Where to edit |
|-------------|----------------|
| Managed mk/agents/CI | boilerplates `partials/rtifact/` or `devops-templates/rtifact-product` |
| IaC resources, Go, profiles | This repo only |
| `make boilerplate-update` | Pull managed files from `rtifact-product` |
| `make tofu-pre-commit-fast` | Run here (fmt, docs, modules, go tidy) |

Installer placement rules: `infra/AGENTS.md#placement`. Provider pins: `build/provider-versions.yml`.
